requirements.text: The system shall allow a patient to book an appointment with a clinician by selecting an available time slot.
A time slot shall be considered available if no other appointment for the same clinician overlaps it.
The system shall send a reminder SMS to the patient 24 hours before the appointment start time.
Patients shall be able to cancel an appointment up to 2 hours before its start time.
The system shall respond to appointment searches promptly.
The booking page shall be seamless and delightful for patients.
The system shall retain appointment records for the required retention period.

labels.note: referent defined nowhere in the set

requirements.text: The system shall prevent new bookings for a clinician during any period the clinician has marked as leave.
If a patient does not arrive within 15 minutes of the start time, the receptionist may mark the appointment as a no-show.
The system shall always be available to patients.
The system shall support a large number of concurrent users.
The system shall send the visit invoice to the patient's insurer.

labels.note: no trigger stated for when the invoice is sent

requirements.text: The system shall store appointment times in UTC and display them in the clinic's local time zone.
Audit logs shall be exported using the agreed format when they grow too big.

labels.note: format defined nowhere in the set

requirements.text: The system shall require clinicians to authenticate with a password of at least 12 characters and a one-time code.
The system shall be robust against invalid input.
Appointment confirmations shall be emailed in a timely manner.
Appointment fee waivers shall be approved.
The system shall display the clinician's next three available time slots on the search results page.
The system shall log every login attempt, and the log shall be easy to review.

requirements.text: The system shall lock a patient account after several failed login attempts.
Appointment durations shall be configurable per appointment type in 5-minute increments.
Clinicians shall be able to override a booking only for appointments classified as urgent.
An appointment shall be classified as urgent when the triage nurse assigns it priority level 1 or 2.
Prescription refills shall follow the pharmacy workflow.

labels.note: workflow defined nowhere in the set

requirements.text: Patients shall receive notifications for major schedule changes.
The system shall reject any booking request that does not include a patient identifier, and shall return error code 400.
The patient portal shall be intuitive and load quickly.
Patient records shall be encrypted at rest using AES-256.
The system shall notify the clinician by email when a patient cancels an appointment.
